text: Evidence record, not authority: the per-test timeouts the stated rule gives for one vitest file, from the measured durations listed. Generated by the script named here; do not edit.

rule.text: A test whose worst measured duration exceeds 2500 ms (half the 5000 ms default) gets an explicit timeout of that worst case x 3, rounded up to a whole 5000 ms. The worst case is the largest duration over every observation listed for the test, under load or inside a full run; a duration from a run in which the test failed is a lower bound. Every other test keeps the configured default.

problems: carries 50000 ms, the rule gives 15000 ms: the policy port and the strict policy chain agree on every world in the fixture set, at every instant
